post.summary: Validate integration credentials and, for Chat2Desk, the registered webhook
post.description: Checks the connector credentials. For Chat2Desk it also looks the integration's webhook up in the customer's account: healthError is null when healthy, "invalid_credentials", "webhook_not_registered", "webhook_disabled" (Chat2Desk disables webhooks after delivery failures — Re-register re-enables it) or "webhook_check_failed" (Chat2Desk could not be queried; previous health kept).

post.summary: Register (or re-register) the connector webhook with the external platform
post.description: Idempotent. Registers this integration's inbound webhook on Chat2Desk using the CURRENT BASE_URL (the stored webhook_url is only a fallback and is corrected on success). An existing webhook with the same path (/api/webhook/chat2desk/{id}) is updated in place — domain change, secret rotation or rename never create duplicates.

400.description: Connector does not support webhook auto-registration
